description: This file declares the interface for a factory class that creates IPC media pipeline capabilities objects within the Rialto client namespace. It includes licensing information, include guards, and class declarations for creating and accessing media pipeline capabilities via IPC.

classes.name: IMediaPipelineCapabilitiesIpcFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating IPC media pipeline capabilities objects.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Static method to create an instance of the factory.

methods.name: createMediaPipelineCapabilitiesIpc
methods.description: Pure virtual method to create a media pipeline capabilities object for IPC.
